synthesis.paragraph: Five of today's papers carry the tag "Urban Transport and Accessibility", addressing food shopping mobility behaviors in Montpellier, vehicle emission hotspots and active commuting clusters in Surrey, active-mobility green space exposure among Swiss adults, a county-level Congestion Propensity Index for the United States, and transit-based socioeconomic segregation in Beijing. Outside this group, one paper analyzed decadal land use, water spread, and air temperature records to assess urban heat island vulnerability in Madurai, India. Another study conducted a comparative environmental life cycle assessment of beef, bread, and sugar supply chains in South Africa across 10 impact indicators. Finally, a third paper monitored indoor and outdoor microclimates alongside household surveys to evaluate heat stress and health outcomes in an informal settlement in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.
